clue.text: It stops worker going on main line

indicators.note: one piece going on after another means it is attached at the end

parts.note: the main is an old poetic word for the open sea
an ant is the classic worker insect

explanation.surface: A labourer starts work on a main railway line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going on' puts the worker after the main line, so the pieces join in that order.
explanation.definitionFit: A sealing compound plugs gaps, so it is something that stops leaks.

clue.text: Fish brought in to eat for complete change

indicators.note: one piece is brought inside the other

parts.note: to sup is to eat supper or take food
hake is a sea fish

explanation.surface: Fish has been brought in for dinner, a complete change of menu.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought in to' is the insertion signal; 'Fish' and 'eat' read as a meal, but each just supplies a synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: A reorganisation, a radical change of people or structure, as in a company or government.

clue.text: Unpaid player's tum area out of shape

indicators.note: letters out of shape are deformed into a new order

explanation.surface: A weekend sportsman's belly is out of condition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out of shape' rearranges TUM AREA.
explanation.definitionFit: A non-professional who plays for love rather than money is an unpaid player.

clue.text: Top-class puzzle — wow!

parts.note: A is the top grade, as in A1 or A-list
a maze is a puzzle of paths

explanation.surface: A first-rate puzzle earns an exclamation of delight.
explanation.definitionFit: To wow someone is to astonish or impress them greatly.

clue.text: One spotted in woods? Amphibians also seen by lake

parts.note: toads are amphibians
too means also
L is an abbreviation for lake on maps

explanation.surface: Something spotted in a forest; frogs and toads too are found near the lake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spotted' means both seen and dotted: the fly agaric fungus has a spotted cap.
explanation.definitionFit: A fungus with a cap, often spotted like the fly agaric, growing in woodland.

clue.text: Quick coffee?

definitions.meaning: the soluble powdered kind of coffee made with a spoon and hot water

explanation.surface: Someone asks if you fancy a quick coffee.
explanation.definitionFit: Immediate is a synonym for quick, and the powdered coffee sold in jars goes by the same word.

clue.text: Single mothers and learned theologians

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one, a single
mams is an informal word for mothers

explanation.surface: Single mothers keep company with scholars of religion.
explanation.definitionFit: Islamic leaders and scholars are learned in theology and Islamic law.

clue.text: Country moans — rain all over the place!

indicators.note: scattered everywhere, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: The whole country complains about rain falling everywhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'all over the place' rearranges MOANS and RAIN together.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny independent republic surrounded by Italy is a country.

clue.text: American student leaves one country for another

indicators.note: the letters leave the word, taken out of it

parts.note: Australia is a country
L is for learner, a student driver

explanation.surface: An American student quits one nation and moves to a different one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaves' takes A and L out of AUSTRALIA; 'another' is the definition, another country.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a second European nation, distinct from the first one named in the clue.

clue.text: Loveless pair become confused in senseless talk

indicators.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O, and 'less' takes it away

parts.note: two is a pair
to addle is to become muddled

explanation.surface: A couple out of love grow muddled in pointless talk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Loveless' removes O (love, zero in tennis) from TWO, leaving TW.
explanation.definitionFit: Twaddle is nonsense, silly or trivial chatter.

clue.text: State in which a priest entertains a bishop

indicators.note: to entertain a guest is to have them inside your home, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: a lama is a Tibetan Buddhist priest
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: A priest plays host to a visiting bishop somewhere in the country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entertains' puts A B (a bishop) inside A LAMA (a priest).
explanation.definitionFit: It is one of the fifty states of the USA, in the Deep South.

clue.text: Is a name recollected? Not with this!

definitions.text: Is a name recollected? Not with this!

indicators.note: collected again, so the letters are gathered up and put together in a new order

explanation.surface: Can a name be remembered? Not if you have this condition!
explanation.walkthrough: 'recollected' rearranges IS A NAME, and the whole clue describes the condition: with it you cannot recall names.
explanation.definitionFit: Memory loss is exactly the state in which names cannot be recalled.

clue.text: Elves seen cooking snack

indicators.note: cooking ingredients changes them, so these letters are reworked into a new order

explanation.surface: Little elves are spotted making a bite to eat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooking' rearranges ELVES SEEN.
explanation.definitionFit: A British mid-morning bite to eat, taken around eleven o'clock, with tea or coffee.

clue.text: Parched, swallowing cold bitter

indicators.note: swallowing takes something inside, so one piece goes into the other

parts.note: parched land is arid, very dry
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on a tap

explanation.surface: A thirsty drinker gulps down a cold bitter beer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swallowing' puts C inside ARID. 'bitter' looks like the British beer but is the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Acrid describes a sharp, pungent, harsh taste or smell, close to bitter.

clue.text: Coat American found behind recreational area

indicators.note: one piece found behind another comes after it

parts.note: a park is a public space for leisure

explanation.surface: A US coat is discovered at the back of the park.
explanation.walkthrough: 'found behind' places A after PARK.
explanation.definitionFit: A hooded, padded jacket for cold weather is a kind of coat.

clue.text: Approve increase after Henry invested in car

indicators.note: one piece comes after the other
one piece invested in another is placed inside it

parts.note: auto is short for automobile, a car
H is the symbol for the henry, unit of inductance
a rise is an increase

explanation.surface: A boss signs off on a pay rise after Henry puts money into a car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'invested in' is the insertion signal, not finance; the henry is the unit of electrical inductance, symbol H.
explanation.definitionFit: To authorise is to give official permission or sanction, which is to approve.

clue.text: Start talk having necked one drink

indicators.note: necking a drink is downing it, so one piece takes the other inside

parts.note: to orate is to give a formal talk
I is the Roman numeral one
gin is a spirit drink

explanation.surface: A speaker begins the speech after downing a quick gin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having necked' is the insertion signal: to neck a drink is British slang for downing it quickly.
explanation.definitionFit: To originate is to begin or arise, a synonym for start.

clue.text: Revolutionary princess rises up behind

indicators.note: revolving means turning round, so the word is reversed

parts.note: a rani is an Indian princess or queen
to rear is to rise up on the hind legs

explanation.surface: A revolutionary princess stands up from behind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Revolutionary' reverses RANI into INAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Owing payments that are overdue means being behind with them.

clue.text: Cigar that's brown put back in Spanish dish

indicators.note: one piece goes in another

parts.note: paella is the Spanish rice dish

indicators.note: put back means the word is written in reverse order

parts.note: tan is a light brown colour

explanation.surface: Something brown has been returned inside a pan of paella.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put back' turns TAN into NAT, which goes 'in' PAELLA.
explanation.definitionFit: A long, slender, straight-sided type of cigar.

clue.text: Scooped-out potato on board fit to ingest

indicators.note: with its inside scooped out, only the outside letters remain

parts.note: board is a table, as in bed and board

explanation.surface: A hollowed potato sits on the board, ready to eat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scooped-out' leaves PO from potato; in a down clue 'on' puts it above TABLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Potable means drinkable, safe to swallow.

clue.text: English sailor hurried over to tell story

indicators.note: turned over, so the string of letters is read backwards

parts.note: a tar is a sailor
ran means hurried

explanation.surface: An English sailor rushed across to recount a tale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' reverses E TAR RAN.
explanation.definitionFit: To narrate is to give an account of events, relating a tale.

clue.text: Piano used in old-time musical drama?

indicators.note: one piece used in another sits inside it

parts.note: O is the abbreviation for old and an era is a period of time
P is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning softly

explanation.surface: A piano features in an old-fashioned musical show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'used in' puts P inside O ERA.
explanation.definitionFit: A staged work in which the drama is sung throughout with orchestral accompaniment.

clue.text: Severe storms enshrouding Chomolungma

indicators.note: the phrase wraps around the answer, which lies concealed inside it

explanation.surface: Fierce storms wrap the Himalayan peak in cloud.
explanation.walkthrough: 'enshrouding' says the letters lie inside 'Severe storms'.
explanation.definitionFit: Chomolungma is the Tibetan name for the world's highest mountain.

clue.text: Performer such as Garfunkel is brought to vacant theatre

parts.note: Art Garfunkel is the singer of Simon and Garfunkel

indicators.note: empty, with the inside letters gone, leaving the outer ones

explanation.surface: A singer like Art Garfunkel is brought onto an empty stage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vacant' leaves TE from theatre.
explanation.definitionFit: A professional entertainer such as a singer or dancer is a performer.

clue.text: Body part's temperature given approximately

parts.note: or so is a phrase meaning roughly, approximately

explanation.surface: A body part's temperature is given only roughly.
explanation.definitionFit: The trunk of the human body, without head or limbs, is a body part.

clue.text: Mere agent prepared contract

indicators.note: the letters are made ready again in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A lowly agent drew up a deal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'prepared' rearranges MERE AGENT.
explanation.definitionFit: A contract is a formal deal, a legally binding accord between parties.

clue.text: Volatile Stan harbours good and bad feeling

indicators.note: to harbour is to shelter inside, so one piece holds the other
unstable, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Hot-headed Stan nurses a grudge, a good and bad feeling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Volatile' rearranges STAN into ANST; 'harbours' puts G inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Angst is a feeling of deep anxiety or dread.

clue.text: Mysterious European republic on the up

indicators.note: in a down clue, going up means read from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: Eire is the Irish name for the Republic of Ireland

explanation.surface: A European republic is enjoying a mysterious rise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the up' reverses EIRE into ERIE.
explanation.definitionFit: Eerie means strange and unsettling, uncanny and mysterious.

clue.text: Look North?

definitions.meaning: a person's manner or deportment, how they carry themselves
north is a compass direction, the kind of thing a navigator takes

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a person's mien or posture and a compass direction given as an angle.

clue.text: Smooth head shaved close

indicators.note: the first letter is cut off, as a head is shaved

parts.note: smooth skin is hairless

explanation.surface: A smooth scalp has been shaved close.
explanation.walkthrough: 'head shaved' takes the H off HAIRLESS. 'close' is the weather sense, not near.
explanation.definitionFit: Close weather is stuffy and humid, without a breeze or fresh air.

clue.text: Say gold piece

definitions.meaning: gold is an example of a chemical substance on the periodic table, flagged by 'Say'
a component or part of a whole

explanation.definitionFit: Gold is a chemical element, and an element is also a component, a piece of something larger.

clue.text: Power seized by wickedly secret Bond foe

indicators.note: one piece seized by another is held inside it
something done wickedly is twisted, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Power is grabbed by a wicked secret enemy of James Bond.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wickedly' rearranges SECRET into SECTRE; 'seized by' puts P inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: The criminal organisation run by Blofeld is James Bond's recurring enemy in the films and novels.
